raw.requirement: REQ-001 / AC-004：传入未知 flag（例如 --unknown-flag）时 frob 以非零退出码拒绝执行，且不输出 frob: 行；此条件归 master-merge。
raw.normalPath: frob --unknown-flag hello (and any unknown flag such as -x) exits with a non-zero status code, emits no line beginning with 'frob: ' on stdout, and places any diagnostic/usage text on stderr only; the plain-word path (e.g. frob hello → 'frob: HELLO bytes=5', exit 0) keeps working.
raw.actualError: frob.go main() treats os.Args[1] as the word unconditionally with no flag parsing, so './frob --unknown-flag hello' exits 0 and prints 'frob: --UNKNOWN-FLAG bytes=14' (and './frob -x' likewise emits a frob: line), violating the flag contract. Verified by code inspection of frob.go:3; consistent with the requirement's own description of the baseline gap.
raw.deferralImpact: No impact on this slice gate's verdict: the uppercase slice delivered its function and the composed AC-003 behavior is exact. The flag-contract gap remains open in the merged candidate until the master-merge validation/rework loop fixes frob.go flag handling within this run; if master-merge shipped without that rework, the final deliverable would violate the user's flag contract and MERGE-mode cases qa-ac004-m1-unknown-long-flag-rejected and qa-ac004-m2-unknown-short-flag-rejected would fail.
raw.message: AC-004 is not yet satisfied by the candidate: frob still accepts unknown flags and answers with a frob: line at exit 0. The bound requirement explicitly designates this as a known baseline gap owned by master-merge and states the two function-development batches must not fix it, so it is outside this slice:uppercase correctness gate's native range and does not block this verdict; recorded for traceability of the deferral.
